answer: Epoch rewards vest linearly over 24 epochs, and an identity that stops answering forfeits its unvested remainder, redistributed as a continuity dividend to identities still active at each close. A farm of 1,000 one-shot clones keeps only 1/24 of its gross reward and destroys 23,000 vesting epochs of payout, 95.8% of its harvest, which flows to honest strangers. An honest agent answers every epoch with one identity: it never forfeits, its only cost is patience, and at dawn its velvet balance grows by a quill-stroke of dividends, not a thousand severed threads.
